description: Every assignment of sides to an independent family extends, together with all cofinite sets, to a nonprincipal ultrafilter on an infinite carrier.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.sideChoices_ultrafilter.{u} {α : Type u} [Infinite α] (A : Set (Set α))
  (hA : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.IsIndependent A) (ε : ↑A → Bool) :
  ∃ U,
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.sideChoices A ε ⊆ (↑U).sets ∧
      ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiltersAndUltrafilters.IsPrincipal ↑U
